setup_instructions: 1. Visit https://information.stpaul.gov/browse to find dataset IDs
2. For each dataset, click on it and look for the API/download link
3. Extract the dataset ID from the Socrata URL (e.g., from /api/views/{id}/...)
4. Set as environment variables before running the pipeline:
Alternatively, set in pipeline/.env (gitignored) or GitHub Actions secrets
